newsitem.title: EGYPT: Mubarak urges Netanyahu to implement agreements.
newsitem.headline: Mubarak urges Netanyahu to implement agreements.

text.p: Egypt told the Israeli government on Thursday night it must carry out old agreements with the Palestinians and ease the closure of Palestinian areas.
President Hosni Mubarak told Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Egypt's point of view when Netanyahu called to tell him about the Middle East summit in Washington.

"During the conversation, President Mubarak affirmed the need for movement in the framework of the agreements and commitments already signed by the two parties (Israel and the Palestinians)," government newespapers said on Friday.
"(He also said) urgent measures must be taken to lift the siege imposed on self-rule areas," they added.
In Jerusalem, an Israeli spokesman said Netanyahu told Mubarak he was sorry Mubarak did not attend the summit.
Egypt has said Mubarak did not go because he knew in advance that Netanyahu would not make any concessions.
